Dr Mariano Galvez's Requests for Clarification and History of Laws Relating to Land Grants and Inheritance with Regards to the Case of William A. Leidesdorff
volumeInfo.description: Description: Consists of the request of Dr Mariano Galvez, Attorney for the Mexican Court, for clarification of Mexican Law on land grants in force at time of the American occupation of California. Particular focus is laid upon questions of the rights of inheritance with regards to the case of William A. Leidesdorff. Response (ADS, Mariano Galvez) summarises laws of Mexican Territory from the Spanish Colonization, through Mexican Independence and the subsequent changes of the law governing ownership of land by foreigners and the inheritance of that property. In Spanish and English.
